    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",

    "*\"     VALUE(TARGET_LANGUAGE) LIKE  T002-SPRAS",
    "*\"     VALUE(TABLE_NAME) LIKE  TADIR-OBJ_NAME",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      ERROR_DURING_TRANSLATION",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "*  DATA: tlwrkobj LIKE lwrkobj OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,   \"*037d+",
    "*        tlwrkkey LIKE lwrkkey OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "*",
    "*  REFRESH: tlwrkobj, tlwrkkey.",
    "*",
    "*  tlwrkobj-sourcelang = source_language.            \"Quellsprache",
    "*  tlwrkobj-targetlang = target_language.            \"Zielsprache",
    "*  tlwrkobj-objtype    = 'TABL'.        \"Fester Wert",
    "*  tlwrkobj-objname    = table_name.    \"Tabellenname",
    "*  APPEND tlwrkobj.",
    "*",
    "*  CALL FUNCTION 'SKTY_TEXT_TRANSLATION_CALL'",
    "*       TABLES",
    "*            tlwrkobj             = tlwrkobj",
    "*            tlwrkkey             = tlwrkkey",
    "*       EXCEPTIONS",
    "*            codepage_error       = 1",
    "*            text_get_error       = 2",
    "*            trm_get_error        = 3",
    "*            text_pre_edit_error  = 4",
    "*            text_edit_error      = 5",
    "*            text_post_edit_error = 6",
    "*            trm_put_error        = 7",
    "*            text_put_error       = 8",
    "*            OTHERS               = 9.                      \"*037d-",
    "",
    "  DATA: ls_e071 LIKE e071.                                  \"*037i+",
    "",
    "  CLEAR ls_e071.",
    "  ls_e071-pgmid    = 'R3TR'.",
    "  ls_e071-object   = 'TABU'.",
    "  ls_e071-obj_name = table_name.",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'LXE_TRANSLATE_TEXT_WB'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      source_language  = source_language",
    "      target_language  = target_language",
    "      transportkey     = ls_e071",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      object_not_found = 1",
    "      slang_unknown    = 2",
    "      tlang_unknown    = 3",
    "      OTHERS           = 4.                                 \"*037i-",
    "",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.                                         \"*032i",
    "    IF sy-msgty = 'S'                                       \"*032i",
    "    OR sy-msgty = 'I'                                       \"*032i",
    "    OR sy-msgty = 'W'.                                      \"*032i",
    "* Was eine Ausnahme auslöst hat mindestens eine             \"*032i",
    "* Fehlermeldung verdient.                                   \"*032i",
    "      MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'E' NUMBER sy-msgno          \"*032i",
    "              WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.     \"*032i",
    "    ELSE.                                                   \"*032i",
    "      MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty NUMBER sy-msgno     \"*032i",
    "              WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.     \"*032i",
    "    ENDIF.                                                  \"*032i",
    "  ENDIF.                                                    \"*032i",
    "",
    "* FREE: tlwrkobj, tlwrkkey.                                 \"*037d",
    "",

    "FUNCTION trint_call_after_imp_method.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TRKORR) LIKE  E070-TRKORR",
    "*\"     VALUE(IS_E070) TYPE  TRWBO_S_E070",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(IT_E071) TYPE  TRWBO_T_E071",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(IT_E071K) TYPE  TRWBO_T_E071K",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_DATNAME) LIKE  TRBAT-DATNAME DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_UPDATE_LOCKFLAG) LIKE  TRPARI-W_VALID DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_CTC) LIKE  TRPARI-FLAG DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SFW_CALL) TYPE  TRPARI-FLAG DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_STATLOG_FILE) LIKE  TSTRF01-FILE DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_NO_COMMIT_WORK) TYPE  TRPARI-W_VALID DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"  CHANGING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(IT_CLIENT) TYPE  SCTS_CL_RESULTS",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_method_call>   TYPE trmtd_method_call.",
    "",
    "  DATA: lt_method_calls       TYPE trmtd_method_calls     ,",
    "        lv_is_upgrade         LIKE trpari-w_upgrade       ,",
    "        lv_dirtype            LIKE tstrf01-dirtype        ,",
    "        lt_methods            TYPE cts_aims               ,",
    "        ls_method             TYPE gty_method             ,",
    "        ls_spec_pars          TYPE gty_spec_pars          ,",
    "        lv_no_work_found      LIKE trpari-flag            ,",
    "        lv_upgrade_is_running TYPE trparflag              ,",
    "        lv_top_level          TYPE sprot_u-level          .",
    "",
    "",
    "  lv_no_work_found = 'X'.",
    "",
    "* Determine, if request belongs to system upgrade",
    "  IF is_e070-trfunction  =  'P'.",
    "    lv_is_upgrade  =  'X'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    CLEAR lv_is_upgrade.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* type of directory",
    "  PERFORM get_dirtype_from_trfunction USING    is_e070-trfunction",
    "                                      CHANGING lv_dirtype.",
    "",
    "* Lower top level of info messages for recursive calls",
    "  IF iv_sfw_call NE 'X'.",
    "* No inner call of activations from switch framework",
    "    lv_top_level = '2'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "* Inner call of activations from switch framework",
    "    lv_top_level = '3'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* read decription of method calls",
    "* trust CTO_ORDER_GET_METHOD_CALLS: LOCKFLAG will be copied correctly",
    "*       from IT_E071 to LT_METHOD_CALLS-OBJECTS",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'CTO_ORDER_GET_METHOD_CALLS'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      iv_method       = trmtd_after_imp",
    "      iv_is_upgrade   = lv_is_upgrade",
    "      it_e071         = it_e071",
    "      it_e071k        = it_e071k",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      et_method_calls = lt_method_calls.",
    "",
    "* Ensure execution of some methods in a special order before all others",
    "* get the method calls",
    "  PERFORM get_special_method_calls",
    "                CHANGING lt_methods.",
    "",
    "* sort the method calls",
    "  PERFORM sort_method_calls",
    "              USING",
    "                 lt_methods",
    "              CHANGING",
    "                 lt_method_calls.",
    "",
    "* call the methods",
    "  LOOP AT lt_method_calls ASSIGNING <ls_method_call>.",
    "    PERFORM get_params_for_method_call",
    "            USING    <ls_method_call>",
    "                     lv_dirtype",
    "                     iv_trkorr",
    "                     iv_datname",
    "                     it_client",
    "            CHANGING ls_spec_pars.",
    "* no call of IAC publishing during switch upgrade including",
    "* included support packages",
    "    IF ls_spec_pars-not_during_upgrade EQ 'X'.",
    "      PERFORM check_for_upgrade CHANGING lv_upgrade_is_running.",
    "      CHECK lv_upgrade_is_running EQ space.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    PERFORM call_imp_methods USING    iv_trkorr",
    "                                      iv_update_lockflag",
    "                                      iv_no_commit_work",
    "                                      iv_ctc",
    "                                      iv_sfw_call",
    "                                      iv_statlog_file",
    "                                      <ls_method_call>",
    "                                      lv_is_upgrade",
    "                                      lv_top_level",
    "                             CHANGING lv_no_work_found",
    "                                      it_client",
    "                                      ls_spec_pars.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "  IF lv_no_work_found EQ 'X'.",
    "*   No object found that has an import method to be executed",
    "    PERFORM log_message USING lv_top_level ' ' '131' ' '",
    "                              space space space space.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*  Write last part of log to file",
    "  PERFORM write_log.",
    "",
